sn11.7:1.2: Bhūtapubbam bhikkhave Sakkassa devānam indassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi || ||
sn11.7:1.3: Yo pi me assa paccatthiko tassa pāham na dubbheyyan ti || || 3.
sn11.7:1.4: Atha kho bhikkhave Vepacitti asurindo Sakkassa devānam indassa cetasā ceto parivitakkam aññāya yena Sakko devānam indo ten-upasaṅkami || || 4.
sn11.7:1.5: Addasā kho bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo Vepacittim asurindaṃ dūrato va āgacchantaṃ ||
sn11.7:2.1: Yad eva te mārisa pubbe cittaṃ || tad eva tvam mā pahāsī ti || 6.
sn11.7:3.1: Sapassu ca me Vepacitti adubbhāyā ti || || 7.
sn11.7:4.6: yo te dubbhe Sujampatī ti || || 1. Sāvatthi nidānam || || 2.
